# Away SEO

> Independent SEO, AEO & GEO consultant with 10+ years of experience. Audits, diagnostics, and actionable strategy for clients worldwide. All prices in USD.

## Pages

- [Home](https://away-seo.netlify.app/) — Online visibility diagnostics & strategy. Specialties, client reviews, FAQ.
- [Services & Pricing](https://away-seo.netlify.app/services.html) — Detailed SEO, AEO and GEO services: technical audit ($49), on-page ($79), off-page ($79), local ($59), AEO/GEO ($59), full audit ($199).
- [About](https://away-seo.netlify.app/a-propos.html) — About the consultant, expertise, and direct contact form.
- [Request an audit](https://away-seo.netlify.app/demande-audit.html) — Form to request a specific audit type. Response within 48 hours.

## Services

1. Technical SEO Audit — $49: crawling, indexing, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, mobile-friendliness.
2. On-Page SEO Audit — $79: title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, schema markup.
3. Off-Page / Link Building — $79: backlink profile audit, competitor analysis, toxic link identification, acquisition strategy.
4. Local SEO / GBP — $59: Google Business Profile optimization, review management, Map Pack tactics, NAP consistency.
5. AEO & GEO Diagnostic — $59: answer engine visibility, AI citation optimization, structured data for AI, brand mention tracking.
6. Full Audit — $199: all five pillars combined with prioritized action plan and follow-up Q&A session.

- Response time: within 48 hours

- Payment: secure payment link after quote validation
